Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2

notes: The French B2 level is stated as a requirement for enrolment ('Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2') but the page does not name accepted certificates. Fee of 178 euros per year applies to the general (French/EU) tariff; no non-EU tuition fee is given for this programme here, so no tuition fact was output. As a Moroccan Bac holder, the applicant applies via Etudes en France / Campus France, so no applicationChannel was output.
